replication.target_description: MTurk replication of Study 2: anthropomorphism versus control on preference for the laptop with more total stars; two preference measures averaged.

n.sample_role: Participants included in final analyses of this replication.
n.exclusions: 41 participants excluded for reporting prior completion of similar studies. MTurk also screened the authors’ list of 11,643 prior workers before recruitment; this list is not subtracted from final N.
n.quote: Ns = 562 in our MTurk replication and 584 in our Prolific replication ... This resulted in 41 exclusions in the MTurk replication, and 22 exclusions in the Prolific replication. ... The sample sizes reported here are the ones included in our final analyses.

p.location: Results, L35-L39; untranscribed main results image at L37
p.quote: the results of the replications were in the right direction but were nonsignificant.

notes: Identity assessment: exact assigned Data Replicada #5 title, datacolada.org/87 URL, May 2020 date and Joe & Leif byline are consistent with the supplied Simmons/Nelson reference. The cache does not expand the byline to full names. First-person methods/results identify a primary replication report, not a preregistration or secondary summary. It identifies original Study 2; its original title says Comparative Choice rather than Comparative Judgment in the neutral reference. This discrepancy does not change identification of the assigned replication report. Article body and footnotes are present, but images, including the main results figure, are not transcribed. No PDF supplied. A trailing failed original-PDF fetch provides no original primary text. Study assignment uses explicit prose: the first replication was run on MTurk; the second, identical replication was run on Prolific Academic. It does not use row order or numeric matching. Only assigned n_r and pval_value_r are completion fields; all other fields are placeholders. N is directly printed and explicitly final; no N arithmetic. The individual target p is unresolved because the results image is not transcribed. Combined p = .071 applies across both replications, and footnote 3 p < .001 applies to manipulation checks, so neither is an individual preference-test p. No numeric bound is inferred from nonsignificance.
